# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in Baguette Tycoon. This is a personal project; discuss substantial changes in an issue before writing code.

## Feedback

Report bugs with reproduction steps, browser, device and the affected build (Full or Basic). For balance feedback, include the unlocked areas, helpers and upgrades. Suggestions should explain the problem they solve.

## Ground rules

- Keep each pull request focused on one change.
- Write code, identifiers, documentation and commit messages in English. Player translations belong in `src/i18n.js`.
- Keep owned code free of comments and long dash characters; use clear names and maintainer documentation.
- Preserve save compatibility and verify Full and Basic behavior.
- Check keyboard, pointer and touch controls, plus portrait and landscape layouts when changing the interface.
- Run lint, economy checks, browser smoke checks and both builds; see `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`.
- Keep temporary captures, local files and release archives out of the repository.
- Respect LICENSE and all asset attribution. A public repository does not grant permission to redistribute the game.
